page_title: FRO 0-0 BOL | Frosinone v Bologna 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Mazzitelli departs the field of play to be replaced by Luca Garritano (Frosinone).
85' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) replacing Matias Soule.

83' Santiago Castro (Bologna) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
83' Daniele Orsato blows for a foul after Pol Lirola (Frosinone) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
81' Joshua Zirkzee goes off the pitch and Santiago Castro (Bologna) comes on.
77' Demba Seck (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Walid Cheddira.
77' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Victor Kristiansen will be replaced by Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
77' It will be a substitution. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Riccardo Orsolini walks off.
71' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

70' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) blows a huge opportunity after receiving a cross from the free kick. He shoots from just outside of the box, but the ball goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
69' Substitution. Michel Aebischer is replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
66' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Reinier and he is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
66' Substitution. Emanuele Valeri walks off the pitch and Pol Lirola (Frosinone) comes on as a substitute.
65' The ball possession at the moment is 34:66.
62' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' Frosinone spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
59' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
58' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
57' Frosinone are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a throw-in.
52' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
50' Bologna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' Half-time substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is replaced by Kacper Urbanski.
46' Referee Daniele Orsato blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A short through ball almost allows Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.

44' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off a brilliant save.
43' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

41' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Orsato with no other option than to blow for a foul.
40' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
37' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna). Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Bologna are seeing far more of the ball now.
35' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Stefano Turati is equal to it.
32' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) brings his opponent down. Daniele Orsato has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Poor challenge! Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle.
30' The foul by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) was seen by Daniele Orsato who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
30' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) picks up an injury.
28' The resulting set piece from Frosinone is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
27' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

27' Nadir Zortea (Frosinone) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Frosinone.
26' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
25' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
24' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
22' Riccardo Orsolini races towards the box before laying off to Michel Aebischer (Bologna), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
21' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
18' The corner is swung in but Frosinone can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

18' Frosinone are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball goes out of play. Frosinone are awarded a corner kick.
17' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
16' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) brings an opponent down and Daniele Orsato interrupts the game.
15' Reinier (Frosinone) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) was quite harsh and Daniele Orsato didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

10' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Lukasz Skorupski is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
7' Reinier (Frosinone) makes a slide tackle, but referee Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
7' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
7' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

6' Emanuele Valeri (Frosinone) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Reinier (Frosinone) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.

2' Bologna exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will take a throw-in.
1' Remo Freuler (Bologna) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Frosinone will take the kick-off.
Daniele Orsato got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
